---
description: "Use when reading or writing Markdown documentation, project docs, specs, or roadmap files. Covers docs-first workflow, terminology, and structure."
applyTo: ["**/*.md", "docs/**/*.md"]
---
# Documentation Guidelines

- Keep documentation aligned with the repository's current architecture and terminology.
- Prefer precise, short sections over broad prose.
- Update docs before or alongside implementation when behavior changes.
- Cross-reference existing documents instead of duplicating content.
- Preserve the project's source-of-truth model: filesystem, local-first, user-controlled.
- When a document describes behavior that is not yet decided, write it as an open question or TODO instead of guessing.
